revenue_growth_yoy.notes: Quarterly revenue YoY growth for Q2 versus the same fiscal quarter last year.

revenue_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter 3-year CAGR computed from reported Q2 revenue facts. Latest quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Prior-year quarter: Single-quarter SEC fact. Q2/Q3 single-quarter values may be derived from year-to-date 10-Q/6-K facts; Q4 may be derived from annual facts minus Q3 year-to-date facts.

eps_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

eps_cagr_3y.notes: Latest-quarter GAAP diluted EPS 3-year CAGR computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

free_cash_flow.notes: Latest-quarter free_cash_flow: Quarterly free cash flow computed as operating cash flow minus capex.

roe.notes: Latest-quarter roe: Annualized quarterly net income divided by quarter-end equity.

roic.notes: roic: Quarterly SEC facts were unavailable for roic.

cash.notes: Latest SEC cash or cash-and-equivalent balance fact.

debt.notes: debt: SEC companyfacts did not include usable debt facts.

debt_to_equity.notes: debt_to_equity: Inputs required for this open/free computation were unavailable.

days_to_next_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-11-04) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.

change_1d.notes: Price performance computed from open/free daily close history.

pe.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

forward_pe.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

price_to_sales.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

fcf_yield.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved free_cash_flow in the listing currency.

pe_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.
